items.text:
4. ESTABLISH – RIGHT TURN ONLY
17th Avenue, northbound and southbound, at Judah Street (Supervisor District 7) (Approvable by the
City Traffic Engineer) Ken Kwong, [staff email removed — see the order]



Proposal to establish right turn only to address collisions.

Public Comments: Received comments in opposition during public hearing as well as emails in
opposition prior to and following public hearing. Concerns raised regarding circulation and potential
increased congestion on 18th Avenue. Suggestions made to install traffic signals and to consider
additional improvements at 18th Avenue and Judah Street.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer for implementation.
